summary:
S.M.A.R.T. Standalone Offline HTML Portal for Apostle Nicholas Dlamini.
A completely self-contained single-file HTML web application containing all 11 published books, physical print pricing, Books2Read universal digital links, audio/video/PDF teachings across the 5 content categories, dynamic #tag filtering, sample chapter reader, and an offline prayer journal with persistent browser local storage.
Requires zero installation, node server, or internet connection; double-click to open in any web browser.
